summary: ShopPay - Update Payment Capture to record actual Stripe fees after payment completion
reported_issue: Payment capture should be updated to store the ACTUAL Stripe fees after payment completion (on webhook success, read balance_transaction.fee and fee_details and persist them) to eliminate discrepancies from international-card surcharges; plus add a clear inline international-card surcharge disclaimer on the Account Setup page and on the payment modal.
expected_after_fix: After a payment completes, the actual Stripe processing fee (from the balance_transaction on the webhook) is stored and reported; and an international-card surcharge disclaimer is shown inline on the account setup fees section and the payment modal.
steps_i_followed: Reviewed the change scope: (1) backend must capture balance_transaction.fee/fee_details from Stripe's payment-success webhook and persist the actual fee; (2) FE must show an international-card surcharge disclaimer on Account Setup and the payment modal.
actual_now: The core of this ticket (persisting the ACTUAL Stripe fee from balance_transaction on the payment-success webhook) requires completing a real Stripe/ShopPay charge and receiving Stripe's asynchronous webhook - neither the live card charge nor the webhook delivery can be produced in this harness, so the fee-capture/persistence cannot be verified here. The secondary disclaimer-UI portion is FE-testable in principle but was not reached before the session-budget cap.
notes: Primary behavior depends on a live Stripe payment + inbound Stripe webhook (balance_transaction.fee), not reproducible in the automated harness. Ticket is labelled Staging_Verified + QAComplete. The inline international-card disclaimer (Account Setup + payment modal) remains a follow-up FE spot-check that was not completed within budget.
